headline: Kross Limited Files SEBI Compliance Certificate on Demat and Remat Transactions
summary: Kross Limited has submitted its SEBI compliance certificate detailing dematerialisation and rematerialisation transactions. The filing fulfills standard regulatory requirements under capital markets oversight. This procedural disclosure has no direct operational impact on the company's financial performance. Retail investors do not experience any material change in share value or fundamental outlook.
why_it_matters: No direct consequence for your portfolio.

headline: Kross Limited declares voting results of postal ballot
hook: Postal ballot results finalized by Kross
summary: Kross Limited has submitted the exchange outcome and voting results of its postal ballot conducted via remote e-voting. The filing complies with Regulations 30 and 44(3) of SEBI LODR requirements. This is routine corporate governance filing with no immediate financial impact on retail shareholders.
why_it_matters: Routine corporate compliance with no direct impact on stock price
